title: Value stream metadata parameters (applications, teams, issues, values, segments)
description: Each value stream has its own parameters editable from a detail form: involved applications, involved teams, known issues, general description, created values, and customer segments. These are stored as fields on the ValueStream type and persisted in the value-stream-store. A StreamEditorPanel component in the AppShell provides a slide-out form to edit these fields. The form auto-saves changes to the store.
